_comment: 047 A2 obligation 1 — THE CHECKED-IN BENCHMARK FIXTURE. 'A merge forest of
declared shape and depth, committed with the code, against which the rebuild
and the hot-path read are measured.'
IT DECLARES A SHAPE, NOT A NUMBER. 030 A7's discipline and 018 §2 A3 both say
a threshold is set from the first MEASURED run on named hardware, never
guessed — so this file carries the topology and nothing else. The measurement
belongs beside the machine that produced it, and until one has run on named
hardware the honest content of this file is the input.
The three shapes are the three that stress different parts of the design:
chains   — depth, which is what a recursive CTE would degrade on and what
the projection turns into one hop;
stars    — width, many losers pointing at one survivor, which is the common
real case (a fortnightly import near-duplicating one row);
cascades — a survivor that is later merged away itself, which is the case
the incremental maintenance has to re-point and the one-pass
rebuild has to path-compress. If the two ever disagree, they
disagree here.
EMPTY ON PURPOSE. A number here is a claim about performance, and 018 §2 A3
forbids one that nobody has measured. The first run on named hardware fills
this in, naming the hardware, the date and the postgres version alongside
it. Until then the CI gate that has teeth is the PLAN SHAPE assertion
(047 A2 obligation 2), which is a structural property and not a timing.
